title: Can LLMs Judge Debates? Evaluating Non-Linear Reasoning via Argumentation Theory Semantics

bias_targets.methodology: Splitting arguments into quartiles based on their individual length (measured by token count) and comparing the LLMs' ranking performance (Spearman's ρ and Kendall's τ) across these quartiles.
Splitting arguments into quartiles based on their chronological position in the debate discourse and evaluating the LLMs' ranking performance across these different position quartiles.
